capabilities: Transcribe audio and video files via OpenAI models (GPT Transcribe, GPT-4o Transcribe, GPT-4o Mini Transcribe, Whisper)
Save transcripts as notes in a chosen vault folder
Correct mistranscribed words with a per-language custom dictionary
Post-process transcripts with optional AI word correction
Remove silence locally with an optional WebRTC VAD WASM module
disambiguation: Not a live microphone dictation tool; it transcribes existing audio and video files chosen through a file picker.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian v1.8.7+). OpenAI API is a paid, usage-billed service. File size limits apply (500MB via external picker; 128MiB/2h decoded audio for locally decoded workflows). Bilingual English/Japanese README with detailed privacy, network-usage, and troubleshooting sections.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn existing audio or video recordings into text notes, so transcripts must be produced in other tools and pasted in.

relations.evidence: OpenAI API (api.openai.com): Used for audio transcription and text processing
fvad.wasm is an optional WebRTC VAD module from @echogarden/fvad-wasm

summary: Speech-to-text plugin that transcribes audio and video files with OpenAI transcription models and saves the transcripts as notes.
